title: A Warning in the Print Shop
subtitle: Mechanical rhythm & a spoken intervention
text: A troupe wanted new songbooks printed, but the printshop owner saw that the leading character's name kept coming out crooked. She tapped the copper plate lightly on the desk; a bright ding revealed a thin thread in its seam. Night rain rustled across the roof tiles outside. Someone fled through puddles by the back door, wet footsteps fading away, and the wooden latch rattled against the frame. At the mouth of the alley she heard the candyman striking his small copper gong and asked him to stop the fugitive. She tore open the recovered paper packet with a rustle. Inside were the old lyrics: someone had feared the new play would expose a long-ago impersonation.
